critical_code_review_comments: device_identity.observations() streams the entire v2_shadow_observations collection on every /api/edr/device-trajectory call (Mongo find({}) with no server-side filter) and filters in Python. Fine at 639 docs; add a Mongo query on event.device_iid / event.raw.computer once the substrate grows past a few thousand observations.

routers/edr.py list_endpoints() and get_device_trajectory() each call dir_svc.list_devices() which itself iterates the whole collection. Consider caching per-request or memoising for the lifetime of a request to avoid the O(2N) scan.

EdrTrajectoryResolver.jsx also fetches the entire endpoint list to resolve a single reference — acceptable at 7 endpoints, but a direct /api/edr/resolve-device?ref=... endpoint would be cleaner and would remove the cross-tenant scope leak risk if list_endpoints ever loosened its authorization.

The 'inferred hostname' rows from workspace_cases.ssot are correctly plumbed but currently produce zero rows in this dataset (SSOT host is empty in 484/484 cases). That's expected per the audit — call it out in docs so a future reader doesn't think the INFERRED branch is dead code.
